Name: OrchestralValley
Author: IdioticFruit
Description:
Modpack to replace all stardew OSTs with remakes ranging from orchestral, jazz, etc arranged by multiple people and produced & created by me (im in the process of working on it)
If you would like to contribute to finish this mod by adding your own cover, or etc, feel free to contact me

Note: This is a zip mod over 100mb due to the mod replacing most of the game's songs so this affects the game loading time slightly
